## Scene and background
Falanaras stands alone for a full-body three-quarter-front character design study, wearing his complete Blood Knight armor and open ceremonial combat faceguard, with his two-handed Thalassian greatblade held lowered on a diagonal so the face, chest heraldry, armor silhouette, and weapon remain readable.

## Subjects
Falanaras, one adult male blood elf Blood Knight. He is tall and long-limbed with an athletic swordsman's build, pale ivory skin, a mature angular face, high cheekbones, long pointed ears, vivid fel-green eyes with restrained glow, and white-blond hair in a high full ponytail with two long face-framing locks. His default armor includes an open faceguard rather than a closed helmet: crimson brow plate, pale metallic narrow central brow-and-nasal blade, two swept pale side fins, and a slim upward vertical crest, leaving eyes, cheeks, jaw, ears, and most of the face visible.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Elegant blackened plate over charcoal leather and cloth, deep crimson enamel edging, restrained dark red-gold fittings, layered pointed pauldrons, fitted torso, armored forearms, heavy greaves, broad elven boots, and a long split dark tabard. A bold crimson Blood Knight phoenix is centered on the chest/tabard. Preserve an unmistakable high-elven Gothic silhouette while reducing the crude bulk of the game model only enough for graceful mobility. White-blond ponytail rises strongly behind the open faceguard. The oversized asymmetrical single-edged Thalassian two-handed greatblade has a dark red-gold hilt and a broad pale metal blade suffused with fiery crimson-to-red-gold stolen Light, while remaining visibly solid metal.

## Action
Standing at controlled readiness, weight balanced, shoulders square, greatblade lowered diagonally beside him rather than attacking; no narrative action.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Severe, watchful, emotionally contained expression conveying conviction and moral burden; direct or slightly off-camera gaze. Upright martial posture without swagger. Keep both hands anatomically convincing around or near the long hilt in a relaxed two-handed ready position.

## Setting and environment
Simple dark charcoal studio-like atmospheric ground with a faint suggestion of blood-elf Gothic arches lost in shadow; sparse by design for an isolated identity study.

## Style, medium, and palette
Warcraft-cinematic stylization: polished high-end digital concept painting, sculptural semirealistic anatomy with elegant Thalassian exaggeration, crisp readable silhouette, richly modeled but selectively simplified armor, convincing metal/leather/cloth, controlled edges, high finish. Palette dominated by black, charcoal, deep crimson, pale ivory, white-blond hair, restrained fel green eyes, and concentrated crimson-red-gold Light.

Vertical full-body character study, three-quarter front view at eye level, entire faceguard crest, ears, ponytail, weapon, and boots inside frame with modest breathing room; approximately 4:5 portrait composition.

## Composition
Falanaras centered slightly left, body forming a tall dark vertical, lowered glowing blade making a restrained diagonal toward the lower right. Chest phoenix and open faceguard are unobstructed. Sparse background keeps the character silhouette and material design legible.

Low-key cool neutral key and rim light define the black armor; the greatblade casts controlled crimson and red-gold bounce onto the nearest gauntlet, tabard edge, and greave. Solemn, formidable, morally burdened rather than triumphant.

images.prompt:
## Intended use
Exploratory isolated character design study comparing a Gothic graphic-fantasy stylization for Falanaras's default Blood Knight appearance; unattached project-library concept art.

## Scene and background
Falanaras stands alone for a full-body three-quarter-front character design study, wearing his complete Blood Knight armor and open ceremonial combat faceguard, with his two-handed Thalassian greatblade held lowered on a diagonal so the face, chest heraldry, armor silhouette, and weapon remain readable.

## Subjects
Falanaras, one adult male blood elf Blood Knight. He is tall and long-limbed with an athletic swordsman's build, pale ivory skin, a mature angular face, high cheekbones, long pointed ears, vivid fel-green eyes with restrained glow, and white-blond hair in a high full ponytail with two long face-framing locks. His default armor includes an open faceguard rather than a closed helmet: crimson brow plate, pale metallic narrow central brow-and-nasal blade, two swept pale side fins, and a slim upward vertical crest, leaving eyes, cheeks, jaw, ears, and most of the face visible.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Elegant blackened plate over charcoal leather and cloth, deep crimson enamel edging, restrained dark red-gold fittings, layered pointed pauldrons, fitted torso, armored forearms, heavy greaves, broad elven boots, and a long split dark tabard. A bold crimson Blood Knight phoenix is centered on the chest/tabard. Preserve an unmistakable high-elven Gothic silhouette while reducing the crude bulk of the game model only enough for graceful mobility. White-blond ponytail rises strongly behind the open faceguard. The oversized asymmetrical single-edged Thalassian two-handed greatblade has a dark red-gold hilt and a broad pale metal blade suffused with fiery crimson-to-red-gold stolen Light, while remaining visibly solid metal.

## Action
Standing at controlled readiness, weight balanced, shoulders square, greatblade lowered diagonally beside him rather than attacking; no narrative action.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Severe, watchful, emotionally contained expression conveying conviction and moral burden; direct or slightly off-camera gaze. Upright martial posture without swagger. Keep both hands anatomically convincing around or near the long hilt in a relaxed two-handed ready position.

## Setting and environment
Near-black graphic field with faint blood-elf Gothic arch shapes and crimson geometric accents kept subtle behind the silhouette; sparse by design for an isolated identity study.

## Style, medium, and palette
Gothic graphic fantasy illustration: sharply designed planar anatomy, angular ink-like contour accents, simplified interlocking armor masses, hard-edged cel-like shadow shapes, selective textured brush grain, limited-value poster clarity, and restrained decorative linework inspired by carved Thalassian ornament. Palette dominated by near-black, charcoal, deep crimson, pale ivory, white-blond, small fel-green eyes, and flat-to-luminous red-gold blade accents. Sophisticated adult graphic-novel cover language, not cartoon comedy.

## Camera and framing
Vertical full-body character study, three-quarter front view at eye level, entire faceguard crest, ears, ponytail, weapon, and boots inside frame with modest breathing room; approximately 4:5 portrait composition.

## Composition
Falanaras centered slightly left, body forming a tall dark vertical, lowered glowing blade making a restrained diagonal toward the lower right. Chest phoenix and open faceguard are unobstructed. Use the phoenix, pointed faceguard, shoulders, ponytail, and blade as bold interlocking graphic shapes.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
Severe high-contrast value design: cool pale face and hair against near-black armor, narrow crimson edge accents, and a hard red-gold blade glow. Austere, disciplined, politically charged, and morally tense.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: Primary front-view design reference for Falanaras's identity, open faceguard, face, chest heraldry, and front armor construction.. Preserve: White-blond high ponytail and long front locks; pale angular blood-elf face; fel-green eyes; open crimson-and-pale faceguard with central nasal element and upward points; black armor with crimson edging; phoenix chest emblem; broad luminous blade.. Must change: Replace game-model rendering, idle stiffness, low-detail materials, crude proportions, and screenshot background with the specified Gothic graphic-fantasy language, controlled pose, and designed near-black field.. Image id: 028de323-17a7-443d-be32-1bec84489db9.
Provider input image 2: Three-quarter armor, faceguard, weapon-profile, and ponytail design reference for Falanaras.. Preserve: Layered pointed armor silhouette, fitted long tabard, high ponytail volume, long facial hair locks, open side profile of faceguard, asymmetrical broad elven blade and red-orange magical fire.. Must change: Use the target three-quarter-front stance and graphic rendering; do not copy the exact game pose, camera, proportions, or screenshot background.. Image id: 75bf57fa-3d0f-430d-8fbf-eabe7c8a1c52.
Provider input image 3: Rear silhouette and construction reference for Falanaras's ponytail, tabard, pauldrons, and greatblade scale.. Preserve: Strong high ponytail silhouette, long dark rear tabard, layered shoulders, red-edged black armor, and oversized blade scale.. Must change: Show the target full three-quarter-front view; do not use the rear pose or place the sword across his back.. Image id: 2b0a4f50-b906-43f0-b656-66b8c0e65997.

## Constraints and exclusions
Preserve the supplied turnaround's recognizable open faceguard construction, hairstyle, armor palette, phoenix emblem, and broad asymmetrical blade. The faceguard must not become a closed helmet, crown, hood, or full mask. Keep one character, one greatblade, two arms, two hands, and full-body anatomy clear. Adult dark-fantasy tone. No scenery clutter, captions, lettering, logos, UI, border, or watermark.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
